result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image obstruct the sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The environment features a multi-lane roadway with a wide grassy median and marked zebra crosswalks. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, curb ramps, and a bus shelter are present, the lack of signalization or traffic calming measures on a wide thoroughfare creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign, increasing the risk of multi-threat crashes.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner on the right has a wide radius which allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, endangering pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install RRFBs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the uncontrolled crossing and increase yielding rates.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds at the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection with multiple travel lanes and marked crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge island create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks in the asphalt surface could present a minor tripping hazard or affect mobility device stability.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
